Evialina Jurjeŭna Laskevich ( Belarusian : Эвяліна Юр’еўна Ласкевіч born 10 November 2004) [ 1 ] is a Belarusian professional tennis player. Laskevich has a career-high WTA singles ranking of 340, achieved on 29 July 2024. She also has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 317, achieved on the same date. [ 2 ] Laskevich won her first bigger ITF title in April 2024, at the W50 event in Lopota , Georgia.
